# Vietnamese Lunar Calendar (Lịch Âm Việt Nam)

> Free, open-source Vietnamese lunar calendar (.ics) in GMT+7 (UTC+7), available in Vietnamese and English for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Microsoft Outlook.

- [Web Studio (Browser Customizer)](https://cmduyeen.github.io/lich-am-viet-nam/)
- [Vietnamese guide](README.md)
- [English guide](README.en.md)
- [Public feeds](docs/FEEDS.md)
- [Holiday catalog](docs/HOLIDAYS.md)
- [Blog & Tools](https://cmduyeen.github.io/tools/)

## Subscription Feeds (.ics)
- Vietnamese Daily (all lunar dates + holidays): `output/viet_lunar_latest.ics`
- English Daily (all lunar dates + holidays): `output/viet_lunar_en_latest.ics`
- Vietnamese Minimal (holidays, Tet, 1st & 15th only): `output/viet_lunar_minimal_latest.ics`
- English Minimal (holidays, Tet, 1st & 15th only): `output/viet_lunar_en_minimal_latest.ics`

All feeds cover the current year and next year in UTC+7. Personal dates stay in ignored local files. Observances are not statutory leave schedules. No web server or AI runtime is required.
